mapper.insert: /* Baim01Mapper.mergeSiteInfo */ INSERT INTO TB_SITE ( SITE_CD , SITE_NO , SITE_NM , CMPNY_CD , ADDR_1 , ADDR_2 , ZIP_CODE , STR_DATE , END_DATE , USE_YN , SITE_ADMIN_CD , TEL_NO , GPS_RANGE , SITE_DESC , LAT , LON , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE , UPDATE_NO , UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{siteCd} , COALESCE(NULLIF(#{siteNo}, ''), #{siteCd}) , #{siteNm} , #{gvCmpnyCd} , #{addr1} , #{addr2} , #{zipCode} , REPLACE(#{strDate}, '-', '') , CASE WHEN #{useYn} = 'Y' THEN NULL ELSE DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d') END , #{useYn} , #{siteAdminCd} , REPLACE(#{telNo}, '-', '') , #{gpsRange} , #{siteDesc} , #{lat} , #{lon} , #{gvUserCd} , NOW() , #{gvUserCd} , NOW() ) AS NEW ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SITE_NO = NEW.SITE_NO , SITE_NM = NEW.SITE_NM , ADDR_1 = NEW.ADDR_1 , ADDR_2 = NEW.ADDR_2 , ZIP_CODE = NEW.ZIP_CODE , STR_DATE = NEW.STR_DATE , END_DATE = NEW.END_DATE , USE_YN = IFNULL(NEW.USE_YN, 'Y') , SITE_ADMIN_CD = NEW.SITE_ADMIN_CD , TEL_NO = NEW.TEL_NO , GPS_RANGE = NEW.GPS_RANGE , SITE_DESC = NEW.SITE_DESC , LAT = NEW.LAT , LON = NEW.LON , UPDATE_NO = NEW.UPDATE_NO , UPDATE_DATE = NEW.UPDATE_DATE

/* Baim01Mapper.mergeMasterSiteAuthSet */ INSERT INTO TB_USER_SITE_AUTH ( CMPNY_CD , USER_CD , SITE_CD , USE_YN , INSERT_NO , INSERT_DATE , UPDATE_NO , UPDATE_DATE ) SELECT A.CMPNY_CD , A.USER_CD , #{siteCd} AS SITE_CD , 'Y' AS USE_YN , #{gvUserCd} , NOW() , #{gvUserCd} , NOW() FROM TB_USER A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} /* PRAFTA-042 H-2: 테넌트 격리 - 동일 회사 사용자로 한정 */ AND AUTH_CD IN ('master', 'hr', 'safe', 'system') /* PRAFTA-042-4: 전사 접근 역할 + 시스템 관리자 계정 */ ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE USE_YN = VALUES(USE_YN) , UPDATE_NO = VALUES(UPDATE_NO) , UPDATE_DATE = VALUES(UPDATE_DATE)
